speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing agitation and notice a yellowish discoloration in your skin and eyes; have you been feeling unusually tired or losing your appetite recently? To understand the cause of these symptoms, I need to review your recent laboratory results. REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel, Bilirubin, and CBC.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver Function Panel: Bilirubin 25 mg/dL (elevated), AST 600 IU/L (elevated), ALT 650 IU/L (elevated), INR 1.5 (elevated), TP Activity < 40% (reduced). CBC: Hemoglobin 16.3 g/dL, Hematocrit 47%, Leukocyte Count 9,750/mm3, Neutrophils 58%, Bands 2%, Eosinophils 1%, Basophils 0%, Lymphocytes 24%, Monocytes 2%, Platelet Count 365,000/mm3.

speaker: Doctor
text: The lab results show significantly elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin, indicating severe hepatocellular injury. Have you consumed large amounts of alcohol recently, or have you taken any new medications or supplements? REQUEST TEST: Alcohol level, Acetaminophen level, and Viral Hepatitis panel (A, B, C).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Alcohol Level: Positive (Elevated), Acetaminophen Level: Detectable (Elevated), Viral Hepatitis Panel (A, B, C): Negative

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute alcoholic hepatitis with acetaminophen toxicity.
